title: TAM Sunday Showcases
kicker: Sunday nights at TAM · artists wanted
lede: TAM's Sunday Showcases put the best acts from our open nights on a proper stage: a full set, a real audience, sound and lights, filmed in the Temple. Want to play one? The way in is the open mic circuit.

steps.title: Come to an open night
steps.text: Pick a night on the circuit below and come and play. Every showcase artist starts here: it's how we hear you live, in the room.

steps.title: Say hello to the host
steps.text: Introduce yourself to the night's host. Our hosts are the people who recommend acts for the Sunday Showcases.

steps.title: Register your interest
steps.text: Tell us about your act with the form below, including which open night you've played or are coming to. We'll be in touch when a showcase fits.

circuit.name: TAM Open Mic
circuit.for: Singer-songwriters, bands and solo players of every style.

circuit.name: The Original Singers Club
circuit.for: Singers: bring a song, sing it live with an audience and get filmed and recorded.

circuit.name: The Great British Blues Jam
circuit.for: Blues players: sign up for a Saturday and the host calls you up with the house band.

circuit.name: Junior Open Mic / JOM
circuit.for: Young musicians, with JOM Youth Music. Under-18s come with a parent.

circuit.name: Open nights
circuit.for: TAM's other open nights and jams, as they're announced.

microsite.title: TAM Sunday Showcase
microsite.lede: Every Sunday Showcase puts the best new acts from TAM's open nights on a real stage, in front of a real crowd, at the Temple of Art and Music in Elephant & Castle. Come and watch for free, get on the circuit, or join the crew.

leads.title: Open nights
leads.text: Where it starts: play TAM Open Mic, The Original Singers Club, the Blues Jam or Junior Open Mic, and meet the hosts.

leads.title: Sunday Showcase
leads.text: A full set with a real sound system and crowd, plus your own page on tam.tv with a fan wall and invite cards to share.

leads.title: Christmas Showcase Special
leads.text: Fans vote for the acts they want to see at The Best Christmas Ever, TAM's Christmas festival.

leads.title: TAM's own nights
leads.text: Acts the crowd loves can be invited back to TAM's own nights and onto TAM TV.

microsite.crew: The Showcase Crew is everyone who loves new music at TAM: fans who come to cheer, and musicians on their way up. Join to hear about each showcase first, who's playing, and how to get on the line-up.
